howToApply: Create a valid personal Email ID and keep it active until the selection process is fully completed, as all communications including call letters are sent via email.
Visit the official website: https://slprb.ap.gov.in
Register with your basic details and note down the registration number generated.
Log in and fill in the required details in the online application form (STAGE I).
Scan and upload your photograph, signature, SSC certificate, community certificate (BC/SC/ST, if applicable), EWS certificate, and Non-Creamy Layer certificate (if applicable).

Pay the application fee online via credit card, debit card, net banking, or other available modes on the SLPRB website, and press “Submit” – failing to submit after paying the fee results in rejection with no refund.
Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Written Test (where applicable) must revisit the website to upload the STAGE II application along with scanned copies of further required certificates.
Once submitted, no changes can be made – ensure all information matches your official certificates and mark sheets before final submission.
